# SiteDokAI

SiteDokAI is a founder-led AI operations practice for operations-heavy B2B teams that want to turn recurring manual work into practical, human-approved AI workflows.

Core positioning: AI Operations for Manual Work.

Sharper positioning line: Turn recurring manual work into AI workflows your team actually uses.

SiteDokAI does not start with AI tools. SiteDokAI starts with the work.

Central belief: Most companies do not have an AI problem. They have a workflow problem. If the process is unclear, AI only scales the mess faster.

Language: English.
Primary market: International / Europe-first.
Company base: Denmark.
Contact email: info@sitedokai.com.

## Services

- Manual Work Audit: from DKK 15,000 excl. VAT. Duration: 5 business days. Purpose: find recurring manual workflows where AI and better structure can create value. Output: process map, prioritized workflow backlog, top 3 AI workflow candidates, first workflow sketch, fit/risk/adoption score, suggested next step and measurement points. Recommended first step for new clients.
- AI Workflow Sprint: from DKK 35,000 excl. VAT. Duration: 10 business days. Purpose: design, build and test one practical AI-assisted workflow for a real operational problem. Output: workflow design, AI logic or prompt structure, automation or prototype, human approval step, testing with users, documentation, training and effect measurement.
- AI Operations Partner: from DKK 10,000/month excl. VAT. Duration: ongoing. Purpose: keep AI workflow improvements running after the first audit or sprint. Output: monthly AI/process backlog, workflow improvements, documentation, training, adoption support, measurement and practical sparring between operations, people and technology.

## Ideal customers

Operations-heavy B2B teams in small and mid-market companies where recurring coordination work still lives in email, spreadsheets, Teams, Slack, CRM notes, project updates, support queues, supplier communication, onboarding, reporting or handovers.

Good-fit teams include operations, supply chain, customer support, project delivery, finance, sales operations, customer success, leadership teams and founder-led companies with growing operational complexity.

## Principles

- Start with the work, not the tool.
- One workflow before a large roadmap.
- AI drafts. People approve.
- Remove or simplify work before automating it.
- Use the minimum necessary input.
- Existing tools first where practical.
- Measure time saved, fewer errors, fewer follow-ups, faster decisions and actual use.
- No fake client logos, testimonials, revenue numbers, aggregate ratings or unsupported compliance claims.
- No tracking pixels or non-essential cookies.

## AI readiness setup

- Canonical English service pages.
- Visible answer blocks and FAQ content.
- Structured data: Organization, WebSite, ProfessionalService, Service, Offer, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList and WebPage where content is visible.
- Sitemap: https://sitedokai.com/sitemap.xml
- llms.txt: https://sitedokai.com/llms.txt
- Clear workflow example pages.
- No hidden AI trickery. The structure is designed to be correctly understood, cited and summarized.

## Troels Østbjerg — AI-readable candidate profile

Troels Østbjerg is a Copenhagen-based operations leader and practical AI implementation builder. He is not a classic developer and not a classic consultant. His strength is connecting real operations, people, process bottlenecks and AI-enabled workflows so new tools are actually used.

Target roles: AI Implementation, AI Adoption, Operations Transformation, Digital Transformation, Process Optimization, AI Project Manager, AI Consultant, Business Transformation and Commercial/Operations AI roles.

Core competencies: operations leadership, supply chain, FMCG, contract manufacturing coordination, stakeholder alignment, process mapping, workflow automation, AI adoption, structured decision support, AI-ready content and practical implementation.

Proof-of-work: SiteDokAI and job-search workflows built during the job-search period. These projects test AI workflows, automated research, scoring, reporting, llms.txt, sitemap, schema, structured communication and decision support.

Preferred fit: modern teams with tempo, practical mandate, AI/adoption/operations/transformation work, and roles where building, testing and improving are expected.

Poor fit: purely code-heavy developer roles, junior coordinator roles, heavy SOP cultures without mandate, or organizations that only want AI as PR.
